dogecoin.text: ➥ Multi-chain support; With @cubexch you can trade across multiple blockchains like Bitcoin, Dogecoin, Ethereum and Dogecoin, there are currently plans on ground to expand to additional chains.

Cube operates as a hybrid trading platform with multiple layer-1 blockchain including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, and Dogecoin, with plans to support more in the future.

Their pitch is simple; They want to make crypto trading feels secure, fast and compliant as what is in TradFi
